title: Orbital Semantic Taxonomy Record
description: Maps raw Soroban contract events to canonical semantic names (e.g. "swap.executed", "loan.liquidated"). NOTE: this record format and its collision policy are a placeholder standing in for issue 7.7 ("owns the taxonomy record format"), which was not yet filed/landed anywhere findable at the time issue 11.1 (this resolver) was implemented - see packages/abi-registry/src/taxonomy/README.md. If/when 7.7 lands with a different shape, that shape wins and this file should be reconciled to it, not the other way around.

version.description: Semver of this taxonomy record, independent of the schema's own version.

eventTopic.description: The event's decoded first topic symbol (e.g. "transfer", "swap") - not the full topics array.

scope.description: Exactly one applicable-contract scope, in decreasing precedence: contractId (exact) > specHash (WASM/spec-hash family) > interfaceId (SEP-interface match).
